objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction subject to lifecycle management including creation, editing, release, distribution, and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the document in the document pyramid (1-4).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation used in the document name (e.g. RL for guideline).

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title portion of the document name.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force, Archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the current released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the current released version is valid.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period the document is retained after invalidation before physical deletion.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original Office format of the document content (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document.

attributes.name: client
attributes.description: Client(s) in which the document is visible in a multi-client system.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document linked to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document, published directly via property switches.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the additional information (e.g. Published, Deleted).

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal created by any author to suggest changes to an existing released document without affecting its content or version history directly.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. Created, Scheduled, Completed).

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, triggering a workflow to extend or revise the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the validity extension request.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate a released document that has no additional validity, triggering the archiving workflow.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the override request.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document, created by the Business Admin group.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who participates in document management in one or more roles (author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader).

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role(s) assigned to the user (Reader, Author, etc.).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used for assigning read authorizations, distribution, and archive access.

attributes.name: group_type
attributes.description: Type of user group (e.g. Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive, Business Admin).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A per-document list of user groups and persons who are notified or required to acknowledge upon document release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by e-mail or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A workflow instance that supports the approval, validity extension, override, reactivation, or acknowledgement process.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (Release, Validity Extension, Override, Reactivation, Acknowledgement, Translation Release).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the workflow instance.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature provided by a workflow participant to confirm completion of a workflow step.

attributes.name: signer_role
attributes.description: Role of the signer (Author, Reviewer, Releaser).

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the signature was provided.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type, used when creating new documents.

attributes.name: template_name
attributes.description: Name of the template.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system with selection of document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The document type selected during creation.

attributes.name: template_used
attributes.description: The template selected during creation, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated Office editing client.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata or attributes of a document are maintained or changed via the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The document is automatically converted to PDF after saving for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step release workflow (Creator-Review-Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the Creator step of the release workflow with an electronic signature.

evts.name: complete_review_step
evts.description: A reviewer completes the review step (technical or formal check) with an electronic signature.

evts.name: reject_review_step
evts.description: A reviewer rejects the document during the review step, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: complete_release_step
evts.description: A releaser completes the release step with an electronic signature, finalizing document release.

evts.name: reject_release_step
evts.description: A releaser rejects the document during the release step, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: The document is automatically published after release and becomes visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created due to content changes, attribute changes, attachment changes, or scheduled change proposals.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A new controlled attachment is created and linked to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving; actual archiving occurs upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is created and linked to a document without affecting the document's version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is deleted from a document without affecting the document's version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for a released document by a user with author rights.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the associated document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is documented as completed by the author; the proposal creator is notified.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before a document's validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: A releaser (or author/reviewer/releaser team) confirms the document's continued validity, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate and archive a document.

evts.name: complete_override
evts.description: The override process is completed; the document receives Out of Force status and authorizations are revoked except for the archive group.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: The Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate an archived document.

evts.name: complete_reactivation
evts.description: The reactivation is confirmed, creating a new version of the document with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to a document via user group or personal assignment.

evts.name: revoke_authorization
evts.description: Authorizations are revoked from a document, typically during archiving.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are notified by e-mail upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are requested to actively confirm acknowledgement upon document release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a released document via a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: start_translation
evts.description: Translation of a released document's content into another language is initiated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version is checked and released via workflow, making it visible to readers in the corresponding language.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: A document is physically deleted from the system after the archive duration has expired.

o2o.description: An attachment is a controlled sub-document linked to and released with a main document.
Additional information is a supplementary attachment linked to a document without affecting its release cycle.
A change proposal belongs to and is displayed within a specific document.
A validity extension request is linked to the document whose validity needs to be checked.
An override request is linked to the document to be invalidated and archived.
A reactivation request references the archived document to be reactivated.
A distribution list is maintained per document for notification and acknowledgement purposes.
User groups are assigned to a distribution list for email notification or acknowledgement.
Users are members of user groups that determine their authorizations and distribution assignments.
A document template is associated with a document type and used when creating new documents.
Documents can reference other documents via the References attribute.
